action_items: Carry-over (not in scope iter7): GET /api/next-record-no?title= (empty title) still 500s via regex path in server.py _record_no. Not re-exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _record_no builds a case-insensitive regex from unescaped title fragment — an empty or regex-special title still crashes (iter5 note, unresolved).

fisher_price._playable_pass has a loop guard `for _ in range(6)` in make_playable to converge — fine for typical cases but silently truncates if a pathological partition needs more passes. Consider logging when hit.

frontend lib/fp.js grooveConflicts() marks every pair closer than MIN_GROOVE_GAP within a groove, including the chord case (same beat two tones). Because chordConflicts() also fires on those, a two-tone same-beat selection on tones in the same groove inflates both stat-repeats and stat-chords. Not wrong, just noisy UX.

useMusicBox.js play() computes layout.len = (last-first+1)*beatSec + 1.2 which omits revSeconds-based tail; wrap-around pins (near beat 85 → beat 0 across revolution) will still schedule within the same window. OK for current preview but may truncate loop audio.
